turns.text: Good day and welcome to the earnings conference call.
The consumer remains healthy overall though we see early signs of credit normalization. Loan growth was modest.
Net interest income was strong. Charge-offs ticked up and we increased credit provision. Consumer spending was resilient. NIM was stable.
Are you seeing consumer weakness or rising delinquency?
Delinquency rose modestly and we are watching credit deterioration in lower-income segments. Overall the consumer is still healthy.
